verdict.line: You lose if you let Granite Shield reset between trades and eat Ground Slam on cooldown; you win if you punish every Seismic Shard whiff and pull him mid-engage with Apprehend.

brief.thesis: This is a 49.9% matchup over 2012 games because both champions win the fight they start on their own terms: Malphite wants his Granite Shield charged and Ground Slam off cooldown before he leans in, while Darius wants Apprehend and Hemorrhage stacks before he commits. Whoever forces the other to fight off-cooldown wins the exchange.

theirWindow.when: Granite Shield charged and E ready
theirWindow.what: He can walk up, eat your first hit on the shield, then Ground Slam you for armor-scaled magic damage and cut your attack speed. Back off and reset rather than trading through this.

yourWindow.when: His E is down or he Qs in first
yourWindow.what: Ground Slam on cooldown means no attack-speed shred and less magic damage in the trade. If he opens with Seismic Shard to close distance, pull him the rest of the way with E (Apprehend) and unload Q into auto into W before he can reset.

start.why: 50.2% win rate over 1210 games. The regen and block-on-hit blunt his poke from Seismic Shard and let you stand in melee range longer without conceding sustain.

boots.why: 54% win rate over 554 games, well ahead of Mercury's Treads' 49.4%. Malphite has no hard CC until level 6, so the extra move speed is what lets you close distance and stay stuck to him for Hemorrhage stacks between Apprehend cooldowns.

core.why: Part of the 72.4%-over-76-games path. The active haste closes the gap after he disengages and lets you land a full Q-auto-W sequence before he can Ground Slam again.
Builds toward the same 72.4% path; the movement speed stacking keeps you attached to him in extended chases once boots alone aren't enough.
Completes the 72.4%-win-rate core. All four of his damaging abilities are magic damage, so flat magic resist directly reduces his Q, W, E and R output.

situational.when: he leans on brutal strikes and stacks armor often
you are ahead and want to duel through his sustain instead of kiting
his team has extra burst or peel to punish your all-in on unstoppable force

runes.keystoneWhy: Granite Shield forces you to hit through an absorb shell before real damage lands, so a keystone that rewards sustained hits over the trade (stacking damage and healing as the fight goes on) matches how these trades actually play out. Master-tier players instead run Stormraider's Surge for a burst-and-reset style, which suits a more mobile, poke-and-disengage Darius rather than standing in extended trades.

summoners.why: 75.8% pick rate at 49.8% win rate. Ghost gives you the sustained speed to stay on him through his Q slow and close distance when he tries to walk away between E cooldowns; Flash+Ignite (50.4% over 18.4% pick) is the alternative if you want to secure kills before he stacks resistances.

playing.title: Punish every Seismic Shard whiff
playing.detail: Q (Seismic Shard) is his only ranged tool and only gap-closer before level 6, on an 8s cooldown. If it misses, walk him down and trade freely.

playing.title: Trade only when his E is down
playing.detail: Ground Slam deals armor-scaled magic damage and cuts your attack speed on a 7s cooldown. Fighting into it up means eating a shred you don't need to.

playing.title: Pull him when he commits, not before
playing.detail: If he Qs or walks in to engage, fire E (Apprehend) to close the rest of the gap yourself and chain into Q and W before he can back out.

playing.title: Hold R for near-max Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales per stack of Hemorrhage on him, so land Q and autos first and only guillotine once he's close to five stacks.

playing.title: Don't extend trades into Brutal Strikes
playing.detail: When he activates W his Armor and AD spike for a short window. Disengage or wait it out rather than trading through the buff.

playing.title: Never let Granite Shield sit unhit
playing.detail: His passive shield recharges if he hasn't taken damage recently. Keep landing autos or Q every few seconds in extended lane phases so it never comes back online for free.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, win rates, and pick rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade timings, cooldown reads, and lane calls are my own tactical analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Fight Malphite whenever his (E) is on cooldown. If he closes in to use (Q), pull him with [E] to close in on him and deal damage.
